5C.1 SubDoorActor.RegisterWithCompartments → SubFlood::SetDoorState | 5C.2 SubHull.OnBreachesUpdated → SubFlood::CreateBreach (via SubmarineBase handler) | 5C.3 SubCrewCharacter fallback: Definition::FindCompartmentAtLocalLocation
